packageRules.description: Group all @astrojs/* updates into one PR
Group all @fontsource-variable/* updates into one PR
Group the ESLint + typescript-eslint family into one PR
Auto-merge dev-dependency patches and minors after CI passes
Never auto-merge majors — they carry real risk and want human review

Hold typescript majors. typescript-eslint throws at module load on an unsupported TS major, so `pnpm lint` fails before `pnpm check` is even reached — see typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940, which targets TS >=7.1. @astrojs/check also still caps its typescript peer at ^6, so both want to move before this is worth reopening.
Pin visual/perf-load-bearing libs to exact versions so a silent minor can't change behavior unannounced
